title: Platform Fee Percentage by Earned Wage Access Fee Model — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
The fee model on an employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — who pays workers' transfer fees — bears on the platform fee of a completed billing month of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service.

**Clause.** An employer whose live agreement is on the employer-paid fee model earns 10 percent, one on the employer-sponsored fee model earns 5 percent, and any other employer earns no fee-model percentage.

| Live agreement's fee model | Percentage on the completed-month platform fee |
|---|---|
| employer-paid | 10 percent |
| employer-sponsored | 5 percent |
| worker-paid | none |
| no live agreement | none |

**Points of judgement.**
- The fee model is read from the employer's live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement; an agreement that is not live earns nothing whatever its fee model.
- The worker-paid model earns no fee-model percentage.
